residual_conventions.gmres_preconditioned: first k with ||M(b - J x_k)|| <= tol ||M b|| (left preconditioning)
residual_conventions.gmres_true: first k with ||b - J x_k|| <= tol ||b||, same Krylov sequence
residual_conventions.e3_reference: direct Newton solves to max(1e-10 ||R0||, 64 eps (1 + ||u_prev||))
residual_conventions.e3_error_norm: relative 2-norm difference of the final state to the reference trajectory
